example.name: basic_autocad_integration
example.description: A complete Tkinter application that creates basic geometry in AutoCAD
example.context: When you need a simple UI for AutoCAD geometry creation
example.code:
import tkinter as tk from tkinter import ttk, messagebox import threading import win32com.client import pythoncom import logging
class BasicAutoCADTool: """Basic Tkinter tool for AutoCAD geometry creation."""
def __init__(self, root): self.root = root self.root.title("AutoCAD Geometry Creator") self.root.geometry("400x300")
# AutoCAD connection self.acad_app = None self.acad_doc = None self.model_space = None self.connected = False
# UI variables self.status_var = tk.StringVar(value="Not connected to AutoCAD") self.center_x_var = tk.StringVar(value="0") self.center_y_var = tk.StringVar(value="0") self.radius_var = tk.StringVar(value="10")
# Setup logging logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO) self.logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
# Create UI self.create_widgets() self.setup_layout()
def create_widgets(self): """Create all UI widgets.""" # Main frame self.main_frame = ttk.Frame(self.root, padding="10") self.main_frame.grid(row=0, column=0, sticky=(tk.W, tk.E, tk.N, tk.S))
# Connection section self.connection_frame = ttk.LabelFrame(self.main_frame, text="AutoCAD Connection", padding="5") self.connect_button = ttk.Button(self.connection_frame, text="Connect to AutoCAD", command=self.connect_to_autocad) self.connection_status_label = ttk.Label(self.connection_frame, textvariable=self.status_var)
# Geometry section self.geometry_frame = ttk.LabelFrame(self.main_frame, text="Circle Parameters", padding="5")
# Center X ttk.Label(self.geometry_frame, text="Center X:").grid(row=0, column=0, sticky=tk.W, pady=2) self.center_x_entry = ttk.Entry(self.geometry_frame, textvariable=self.center_x_var, width=10) self.center_x_entry.grid(row=0, column=1, sticky=(tk.W, tk.E), pady=2, padx=(5, 0))
# Center Y ttk.Label(self.geometry_frame, text="Center Y:").grid(row=1, column=0, sticky=tk.W, pady=2) self.center_y_entry = ttk.Entry(self.geometry_frame, textvariable=self.center_y_var, width=10) self.center_y_entry.grid(row=1, column=1, sticky=(tk.W, tk.E), pady=2, padx=(5, 0))
# Radius ttk.Label(self.geometry_frame, text="Radius:").grid(row=2, column=0, sticky=tk.W, pady=2) self.radius_entry = ttk.Entry(self.geometry_frame, textvariable=self.radius_var, width=10) self.radius_entry.grid(row=2, column=1, sticky=(tk.W, tk.E), pady=2, padx=(5, 0))
# Buttons self.button_frame = ttk.Frame(self.geometry_frame) self.create_button = ttk.Button(self.button_frame, text="Create Circle", command=self.create_circle, state=tk.DISABLED) self.exit_button = ttk.Button(self.button_frame, text="Exit", command=self.root.quit)
def setup_layout(self): """Configure the layout.""" # Configure main window self.root.columnconfigure(0, weight=1) self.root.rowconfigure(0, weight=1)
# Configure main frame self.main_frame.columnconfigure(0, weight=1) self.main_frame.rowconfigure(0, weight=1) self.main_frame.rowconfigure(1, weight=1)
# Layout frames self.connection_frame.grid(row=0, column=0, sticky=(tk.W, tk.E), pady=(0, 10)) self.geometry_frame.grid(row=1, column=0, sticky=(tk.W, tk.E))
# Connection frame layout self.connection_frame.columnconfigure(0, weight=1) self.connect_button.grid(row=0, column=0, sticky=tk.W, pady=(0, 5)) self.connection_status_label.grid(row=1, column=0, sticky=tk.W)
# Geometry frame layout self.geometry_frame.columnconfigure(0, weight=1) self.geometry_frame.columnconfigure(1, weight=1) self.button_frame.grid(row=3, column=0, columnspan=2, sticky=(tk.W, tk.E), pady=(10, 0))
# Button frame layout self.button_frame.columnconfigure(0, weight=1) self.button_frame.columnconfigure(1, weight=1) self.create_button.grid(row=0, column=0, sticky=(tk.W, tk.E), padx=(0, 5)) self.exit_button.grid(row=0, column=1, sticky=(tk.W, tk.E), padx=(5, 0))
def connect_to_autocad(self): """Connect to AutoCAD application.""" def connect(): try: pythoncom.CoInitialize()
# Try to connect to existing instance try: self.acad_app = win32com.client.GetActiveObject("AutoCAD.Application") self.logger.info("Connected to existing AutoCAD instance") except: self.acad_app = win32com.client.Dispatch("AutoCAD.Application") self.acad_app.Visible = True self.logger.info("Started new AutoCAD instance")
# Get document and model space self.acad_doc = self.acad_app.ActiveDocument self.model_space = self.acad_doc.ModelSpace self.connected = True
# Update UI self.root.after(0, lambda: self.status_var.set("Connected to AutoCAD")) self.root.after(0, lambda: self.create_button.config(state=tk.NORMAL))
except Exception as e: self.logger.error(f"Failed to connect to AutoCAD: {e}") self.root.after(0, lambda: self.status_var.set(f"Connection failed: {str(e)}"))
# Run connection in background thread thread = threading.Thread(target=connect, daemon=True) thread.start()
def create_circle(self): """Create a circle in AutoCAD.""" if not self.connected: messagebox.showerror("Error", "Not connected to AutoCAD") return
try: # Validate inputs center_x = float(self.center_x_var.get()) center_y = float(self.center_y_var.get()) radius = float(self.radius_var.get())
if radius <= 0: raise ValueError("Radius must be positive")
# Update status self.status_var.set("Creating circle...")
def create_circle_task(): try: # Convert to AutoCAD VARIANT format center = win32com.client.VARIANT( pythoncom.VT_ARRAY | pythoncom.VT_R8, [center_x, center_y, 0.0] )
# Create circle circle = self.model_space.AddCircle(center, radius)
# Update UI self.root.after(0, lambda: self.status_var.set( f"Circle created at ({center_x}, {center_y}) with radius {radius}" ))
self.logger.info(f"Created circle: center=({center_x}, {center_y}), radius={radius}")
except Exception as e: self.logger.error(f"Failed to create circle: {e}") self.root.after(0, lambda: self.status_var.set(f"Error: {str(e)}"))
# Run in background thread thread = threading.Thread(target=create_circle_task, daemon=True) thread.start()
except ValueError as e: messagebox.showerror("Input Error", str(e)) except Exception as e: messagebox.showerror("Error", f"Unexpected error: {str(e)}")
if __name__ == "__main__": root = tk.Tk() app = BasicAutoCADTool(root) root.mainloop()
example.explanation: This example demonstrates a complete Tkinter application that connects to AutoCAD and creates circles. Key features include thread-safe AutoCAD operations, proper error handling, and responsive UI design.

example.description: A Tkinter application for managing AutoCAD files and drawings
example.context: When you need to create file management tools for AutoCAD workflows
example.code:
import tkinter as tk from tkinter import ttk, messagebox, filedialog import threading import os import win32com.client import pythoncom import logging from datetime import datetime
class AutoCADFileManager: """Tkinter application for managing AutoCAD files and drawings."""
def __init__(self, root): self.root = root self.root.title("AutoCAD File Manager") self.root.geometry("700x500")
# AutoCAD connection self.acad_app = None self.connected = False
# File management self.current_file_path = None self.recent_files = []
# UI variables self.status_var = tk.StringVar(value="Not connected") self.current_file_var = tk.StringVar(value="No file open")
# Setup logging logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO) self.logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
# Create UI self.create_widgets() self.setup_layout()
def create_widgets(self): """Create all UI widgets.""" # Main frame self.main_frame = ttk.Frame(self.root, padding="10") self.main_frame.grid(row=0, column=0, sticky=(tk.W, tk.E, tk.N, tk.S))
# Connection section self.connection_frame = ttk.LabelFrame(self.main_frame, text="AutoCAD Connection", padding="5") self.connect_button = ttk.Button(self.connection_frame, text="Connect to AutoCAD", command=self.connect_to_autocad) self.connection_status_label = ttk.Label(self.connection_frame, textvariable=self.status_var)
# File operations section self.file_frame = ttk.LabelFrame(self.main_frame, text="File Operations", padding="5") self.new_button = ttk.Button(self.file_frame, text="New Drawing", command=self.new_drawing) self.open_button = ttk.Button(self.file_frame, text="Open Drawing", command=self.open_drawing) self.save_button = ttk.Button(self.file_frame, text="Save", command=self.save_drawing) self.save_as_button = ttk.Button(self.file_frame, text="Save As", command=self.save_drawing_as)
# Current file info self.info_frame = ttk.LabelFrame(self.main_frame, text="Current File", padding="5") self.current_file_label = ttk.Label(self.info_frame, textvariable=self.current_file_var, wraplength=400, justify=tk.LEFT)
# Drawing operations self.operations_frame = ttk.LabelFrame(self.main_frame, text="Drawing Operations", padding="5") self.zoom_extents_button = ttk.Button(self.operations_frame, text="Zoom Extents", command=self.zoom_extents) self.regen_button = ttk.Button(self.operations_frame, text="Regenerate", command=self.regenerate) self.purge_button = ttk.Button(self.operations_frame, text="Purge Unused", command=self.purge_unused)
# Recent files section self.recent_frame = ttk.LabelFrame(self.main_frame, text="Recent Files", padding="5") self.recent_listbox = tk.Listbox(self.recent_frame, height=6, selectmode=tk.SINGLE) self.recent_listbox.bind('<Double-Button-1>', self.on_recent_file_double_click) self.refresh_recent_button = ttk.Button(self.recent_frame, text="Refresh", command=self.load_recent_files)
# Status section self.status_frame = ttk.Frame(self.main_frame) self.status_label = ttk.Label(self.status_frame, textvariable=self.status_var)
# Disable buttons initially self.set_button_states(False)
def setup_layout(self): """Configure the layout.""" # Configure main window self.root.columnconfigure(0, weight=1) self.root.rowconfigure(0, weight=1)
# Configure main frame self.main_frame.columnconfigure(0, weight=1) self.main_frame.rowconfigure(0, weight=1) self.main_frame.rowconfigure(1, weight=1) self.main_frame.rowconfigure(2, weight=1) self.main_frame.rowconfigure(3, weight=1) self.main_frame.rowconfigure(4, weight=1)
# Layout frames self.connection_frame.grid(row=0, column=0, sticky=(tk.W, tk.E), pady=(0, 5)) self.file_frame.grid(row=1, column=0, sticky=(tk.W, tk.E), pady=(0, 5)) self.info_frame.grid(row=2, column=0, sticky=(tk.W, tk.E), pady=(0, 5)) self.operations_frame.grid(row=3, column=0, sticky=(tk.W, tk.E), pady=(0, 5)) self.recent_frame.grid(row=4, column=0, sticky=(tk.W, tk.E), pady=(0, 5)) self.status_frame.grid(row=5, column=0, sticky=(tk.W, tk.E), pady=(5, 0))
# Connection frame layout self.connection_frame.columnconfigure(0, weight=1) self.connect_button.grid(row=0, column=0, sticky=tk.W) self.connection_status_label.grid(row=1, column=0, sticky=tk.W, pady=(5, 0))
# File operations layout self.file_frame.columnconfigure(0, weight=1) self.file_frame.columnconfigure(1, weight=1) self.file_frame.columnconfigure(2, weight=1) self.file_frame.columnconfigure(3, weight=1) self.new_button.grid(row=0, column=0, sticky=(tk.W, tk.E), padx=(0, 2)) self.open_button.grid(row=0, column=1, sticky=(tk.W, tk.E), padx=2) self.save_button.grid(row=0, column=2, sticky=(tk.W, tk.E), padx=2) self.save_as_button.grid(row=0, column=3, sticky=(tk.W, tk.E), padx=(2, 0))
# Current file info layout self.info_frame.columnconfigure(0, weight=1) self.current_file_label.grid(row=0, column=0, sticky=(tk.W, tk.E))
# Operations layout self.operations_frame.columnconfigure(0, weight=1) self.operations_frame.columnconfigure(1, weight=1) self.operations_frame.columnconfigure(2, weight=1) self.zoom_extents_button.grid(row=0, column=0, sticky=(tk.W, tk.E), padx=(0, 2)) self.regen_button.grid(row=0, column=1, sticky=(tk.W, tk.E), padx=2) self.purge_button.grid(row=0, column=2, sticky=(tk.W, tk.E), padx=(2, 0))
# Recent files layout self.recent_frame.columnconfigure(0, weight=1) self.recent_frame.rowconfigure(0, weight=1) self.recent_listbox.grid(row=0, column=0, sticky=(tk.W, tk.E, tk.N, tk.S), pady=(0, 5)) self.refresh_recent_button.grid(row=1, column=0, sticky=(tk.W, tk.E))
# Status layout self.status_frame.columnconfigure(0, weight=1) self.status_label.grid(row=0, column=0, sticky=(tk.W, tk.E))
def set_button_states(self, enabled: bool): """Enable or disable operation buttons.""" state = tk.NORMAL if enabled else tk.DISABLED self.new_button.config(state=state) self.open_button.config(state=state) self.save_button.config(state=state) self.save_as_button.config(state=state) self.zoom_extents_button.config(state=state) self.regen_button.config(state=state) self.purge_button.config(state=state)
def connect_to_autocad(self): """Connect to AutoCAD application.""" def connect(): try: self.root.after(0, lambda: self.status_var.set("Connecting to AutoCAD..."))
pythoncom.CoInitialize()
# Try to connect to existing instance try: self.acad_app = win32com.client.GetActiveObject("AutoCAD.Application") self.logger.info("Connected to existing AutoCAD instance") except: self.acad_app = win32com.client.Dispatch("AutoCAD.Application") self.acad_app.Visible = True self.logger.info("Started new AutoCAD instance")
self.connected = True
# Load recent files and update UI self.load_recent_files() self.update_current_file_info()
self.root.after(0, lambda: self.status_var.set("Connected to AutoCAD")) self.root.after(0, lambda: self.set_button_states(True))
except Exception as e: self.logger.error(f"Connection failed: {e}") self.root.after(0, lambda: self.status_var.set(f"Connection failed: {str(e)}"))
# Run connection in background thread thread = threading.Thread(target=connect, daemon=True) thread.start()
def new_drawing(self): """Create a new AutoCAD drawing.""" if not self.connected: messagebox.showerror("Error", "Not connected to AutoCAD") return
def create_new(): try: self.root.after(0, lambda: self.status_var.set("Creating new drawing..."))
# Create new document self.acad_app.Documents.Add() self.current_file_path = None self.update_current_file_info()
self.root.after(0, lambda: self.status_var.set("New drawing created"))
except Exception as e: self.logger.error(f"Failed to create new drawing: {e}") self.root.after(0, lambda: self.status_var.set(f"Error: {str(e)}"))
thread = threading.Thread(target=create_new, daemon=True) thread.start()
def open_drawing(self): """Open an existing AutoCAD drawing.""" if not self.connected: messagebox.showerror("Error", "Not connected to AutoCAD") return
file_path = filedialog.askopenfilename( title="Open AutoCAD Drawing", filetypes=[("AutoCAD files", "*.dwg"), ("All files", "*.*")] )
if file_path: def open_file(): try: self.root.after(0, lambda: self.status_var.set(f"Opening {os.path.basename(file_path)}..."))
# Open the drawing self.acad_app.Documents.Open(file_path) self.current_file_path = file_path self.update_current_file_info() self.load_recent_files()
self.root.after(0, lambda: self.status_var.set("Drawing opened successfully"))
except Exception as e: self.logger.error(f"Failed to open drawing: {e}") self.root.after(0, lambda: self.status_var.set(f"Error opening drawing: {str(e)}"))
thread = threading.Thread(target=open_file, daemon=True) thread.start()
def save_drawing(self): """Save the current AutoCAD drawing.""" if not self.connected: messagebox.showerror("Error", "Not connected to AutoCAD") return
if not self.current_file_path: self.save_drawing_as() return
def save_file(): try: self.root.after(0, lambda: self.status_var.set("Saving drawing..."))
# Save the current document self.acad_app.ActiveDocument.Save()
self.root.after(0, lambda: self.status_var.set("Drawing saved successfully"))
except Exception as e: self.logger.error(f"Failed to save drawing: {e}") self.root.after(0, lambda: self.status_var.set(f"Error saving drawing: {str(e)}"))
thread = threading.Thread(target=save_file, daemon=True) thread.start()
def save_drawing_as(self): """Save the current AutoCAD drawing with a new name.""" if not self.connected: messagebox.showerror("Error", "Not connected to AutoCAD") return
file_path = filedialog.asksaveasfilename( title="Save AutoCAD Drawing As", defaultextension=".dwg", filetypes=[("AutoCAD files", "*.dwg"), ("All files", "*.*")] )
if file_path: def save_as(): try: self.root.after(0, lambda: self.status_var.set(f"Saving as {os.path.basename(file_path)}..."))
# Save with new name self.acad_app.ActiveDocument.SaveAs(file_path) self.current_file_path = file_path self.update_current_file_info() self.load_recent_files()
self.root.after(0, lambda: self.status_var.set("Drawing saved successfully"))
except Exception as e: self.logger.error(f"Failed to save drawing: {e}") self.root.after(0, lambda: self.status_var.set(f"Error saving drawing: {str(e)}"))
thread = threading.Thread(target=save_as, daemon=True) thread.start()
def zoom_extents(self): """Zoom to extents in the current drawing.""" if not self.connected: messagebox.showerror("Error", "Not connected to AutoCAD") return
def zoom(): try: self.root.after(0, lambda: self.status_var.set("Zooming to extents..."))
# Send zoom extents command self.acad_app.ActiveDocument.SendCommand("ZOOM E ")
self.root.after(0, lambda: self.status_var.set("Zoom extents completed"))
except Exception as e: self.logger.error(f"Failed to zoom extents: {e}") self.root.after(0, lambda: self.status_var.set(f"Error: {str(e)}"))
thread = threading.Thread(target=zoom, daemon=True) thread.start()
def regenerate(self): """Regenerate the current drawing.""" if not self.connected: messagebox.showerror("Error", "Not connected to AutoCAD") return
def regen(): try: self.root.after(0, lambda: self.status_var.set("Regenerating drawing..."))
# Send regenerate command self.acad_app.ActiveDocument.SendCommand("REGEN ")
self.root.after(0, lambda: self.status_var.set("Regeneration completed"))
except Exception as e: self.logger.error(f"Failed to regenerate: {e}") self.root.after(0, lambda: self.status_var.set(f"Error: {str(e)}"))
thread = threading.Thread(target=regen, daemon=True) thread.start()
def purge_unused(self): """Purge unused objects from the current drawing.""" if not self.connected: messagebox.showerror("Error", "Not connected to AutoCAD") return
def purge(): try: self.root.after(0, lambda: self.status_var.set("Purging unused objects..."))
# Send purge command self.acad_app.ActiveDocument.SendCommand("PURGE ALL *
